user.title: Pair a Macon Heat Pump Controller
user.description: On the physical controller, open Settings → Home Assistant and press Start Pairing, then enter the six-digit code it displays. Home Assistant captures and verifies the controller's certificate automatically.

confirm.title: Pair discovered controller
confirm.description: Controller {device_id} was discovered at {host}. On the controller, press Start Pairing under Settings → Home Assistant and enter the six-digit code it displays.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Macon Heat Pump Controller
reauth_confirm.description: Open a new pairing window on the physical controller and enter the six-digit code it displays. The controller's certificate is captured and verified automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller
error.certificate_mismatch: The controller's certificate could not be verified against the pairing response
error.invalid_response: The controller returned an invalid response
error.wrong_device: The pairing response came from a different controller

abort.not_macon_controller: The discovered service is not a Macon Heat Pump Controller
abort.reauth_failed: The config entry no longer exists
